JELLYFISH LANTERN-SWARM — the brass sub drifts through a galaxy of glowing bell-jellyfish, their golden tendrils trailing like silk ribbons, each pulsing dome a warm paper lantern in the teal-black deep.
WHALE SHADOW PASSAGE — a vast dark silhouette drifts across the upper fathoms, blotting the faint surface light, the submarine rocking gently in the ancient creature's slow and cathedral wake.

DROWNED BRASS CITY — toppled colonnades and dome-roofed halls loom from the silt, gaslit windows burning amber behind encrusted glass, the drowned Victorian city glowing faintly as if still inhabited below.

BIOLUM CORAL CATHEDRAL — violet and cobalt light pulses upward from towering coral formations, glowing anemones swaying like censers, the submarine's ornate hull gilded from beneath in cold celestial fire.
KELP-COLUMN FOREST — immense kelp towers rise from the black floor like the pillars of a flooded nave, their amber fronds drifting slow and silent as cathedral banners in still air.
GALLEON WRECK — a barnacled galleon lists in the silt, her rigging draped in sea-lace, scattered doubloons catching the porthole-light, chests yawning open among softly swaying deep-water blooms.
HYDROTHERMAL VENT — a crack in the ocean floor breathes red fire upward, glowing ember-motes drifting past the brass hull, the water shimmering like heated glass above the underworld furnace.
CLOCKWORK FISH SCHOOL — a gleaming school of brass mechanical fish banks and turns in perfect unison, their gear-cut fins catching the sub's lamplight, eyes glowing faint amber in the darkness.
LEVIATHAN STATUE — half-swallowed by silt, an ancient stone sea-beast looms from the gloom, its carved jaw wide, barnacle-crusted fins stretched wide as the wings of a buried cathedral.

SHIPWRECK GRAVEYARD — a forest of tilted masts and broken hulls stretches into the darkness, lanterns still swaying on rusted chains, the submarine threading the silent graveyard like a ghost among ghosts.
JELLYFISH VEIL — a translucent curtain of moon-jellyfish hangs across the sub's path, each bell rimmed in cold blue fire, their trailing threads weaving a glowing net through the lightless fathoms.
WHALE SHADOW ECLIPSE — the immense belly of a passing whale darkens the entire viewport, its barnacled skin close enough to read like a continent, before the great shadow rolls slowly onward.

SUNKEN CLOCKTOWER — a lone Victorian clocktower rises from the seabed, its face still illuminated, hands frozen at midnight, schools of silver fish circling its glowing dial like a congregation at prayer.
CORAL BLOOM AURORA — a low bioluminescent reef exhales pulses of rose and green light in slow rhythmic waves, the sub's hull rippling with reflected color like a vessel sailing through aurora.

KELP LABYRINTH — the submarine winds between towering kelp-columns wider than oaks, their canopy lost in upper dark, shafts of bioluminescence falling through the fronds like light through a stained-glass roof.
TREASURE GALLEON — a great Spanish galleon rests perfectly upright in the silt, her holds burst open, gold ingots spilling down her flank in a slow avalanche frozen by centuries of pressure.
EMBER VENT FIELD — a row of hydrothermal vents lines the ocean floor like a forge-hearth, red light rippling upward in curtains, the brass submarine gilded crimson as it passes the deep furnace.

BRASS FISH MIGRATION — thousands of clockwork fish migrate in a vast shimmering column through the dark water, their ticking audible against the hull, fins and flanks glinting in the submarine's forward lamp.

STONE LEVIATHAN FIELD — three colossal stone sea-serpents lie half-buried in rows, their carved scales crusted white, mouths open toward the surface as if voicing a cry swallowed by centuries of silt.
MAST GRAVEYARD — hundreds of tilted masts rise from the seabed like a drowned forest, flags rotted to lace, the submarine weaving between them in reverent silence through the deep's vast cemetery.

LANTERN JELLYFISH RIVER — a slow river of jellyfish drifts broadside past the viewport, amber and rose and pale green, their bells overlapping like floating lily-pads across a lightless celestial canal.
GREAT WHALE PASSING — the submarine is stilled by the slow transit of an immense whale above, its song reverberating through every rivet and porthole-glass, filling the iron hull with deep vibration.
SUNKEN OPERA HOUSE — a drowned opera house rises from the silt, its balconies intact, a chandelier inside still ablaze with some cold submersible flame, fish drifting through the stalls like patrons.

VENT EMBER STORM — the submarine passes through a drift of glowing particles rising from a fissure below, each mote bright as a firefly, the dark water transformed to a slow ascending snowfall of fire.

CLOCKWORK FISH PARADE — a procession of enormous brass mechanical fish circles the submarine in stately formation, their jointed tails sweeping arcs of silver light, gear-teeth meshing audibly in the crushing deep silence.
WHALE-SHADOW ECLIPSE — far above, the immense dark silhouette of a passing leviathan blots out the surface light, casting the submarine in slow cathedral shadow, vast as a drifting continent.
JELLYFISH PROCESSION — the brass hull glides through a luminous parade of bell-jellyfish, their gold-veined domes pulsing like carried lanterns at some solemn, wordless deep-sea festival.
CLOCKWORK FISH SHOAL — a glittering school of mechanical brass fish parts around the submarine's prow, their articulated fins catching the porthole-light, gears ticking soft as rain on copper roofs.
KELP CATHEDRAL COLUMNS — towering kelp-pillars rise from the murk like nave columns in some drowned abbey, their dark fronds swaying in slow benediction around the passing vessel.
HYDROTHERMAL EMBER VENT — a crack in the ocean floor breathes red-glowing heat, drifting ember-motes rising like the last exhalation of some buried forge god far below.
GALLEON TREASURE WRECK — a barnacle-crusted Spanish galleon leans in eternal surrender, its spilled treasure chests glinting dully, silk-soft silt settling like snow across forgotten gold doubloons.
SUNKEN LEVIATHAN IDOL — a colossal stone face rises half-swallowed by silt, ancient and inscrutable, its hollow eyes deep enough to berth a second submarine within their darkness.
GASLIT BRASS CITY — the submarine drifts past colonnaded ruins of a sunken Victorian city, a handful of gaslit windows still burning amber in the silt-hazed, pressurized dark.
BIOLUM REEF PULSE — violet and blue light ripples outward from the coral cathedral as the vessel passes, anemones trailing like jeweled sleeves, the whole reef breathing in slow electric waves.
WHALE ABOVE THE DOME — a whale's vast belly crosses the green upper water like a slow thundercloud, its deep song resonating through the submarine's riveted brass hull in long, mournful chords.

LANTERN-DRIFT SWARM — ten thousand jellyfish drift in loose procession, warm amber light bleeding from each pulsing bell, the submarine moving through them like a carriage through festival paper lanterns.
EMBER VENT CORONA — superheated columns shimmer upward from a glowing fissure, the surrounding seabed crusted brilliant orange and white, beautiful as stained glass held against a furnace light.
MECHANICA FISH VORTEX — the clockwork school spirals in a luminous helix around the conning tower, each brass body catching and throwing light, the collective ticking rising to a soft mechanical hum.
KELP-FOREST GLOOM — the submarine threads between kelp-towers wide as oaks, their canopy closing overhead like vaulted arches, filtering all light to a deep, amber-green cathedral twilight.
SILT-BURIED COLOSSUS — only the stone leviathan's ridged spine and one enormous claw protrude from the seabed silt, implying a buried enormity that dwarfs even the submarine's brass bulk.
GRAVEYARD OF MASTS — a dozen wrecked vessels list together in communal ruin, their tilted masts interlocking overhead like fingers clasped, barnacled lanterns swaying in the deep cold current.
GALLEON GHOST-HOLD — through a gaping galleon wound the submarine's searchlight finds a cascade of pearls still pouring from a split chest, falling in perpetual slow-motion into the silt below.

DROWNED DOME DISTRICT — rows of submerged Victorian domes and iron-lace balconies pass in review, a gaslit drawing-room window glowing behind intact glass, curtains swaying in the pressured current within.

JELLYFISH AURORA — a ceiling of bioluminescent jellyfish above transforms the dark water into a shimmering aurora, their tendrils hanging like the fringe of some vast, slowly breathing golden tapestry.

STONE IDOL GARDEN — several leviathan-statues of graduated size emerge from the silt in rough alignment, their barnacled faces all turned as if watching the submarine's passage with patient, oceanic attention.
CORAL SPIRE FOREST — bioluminescent coral spires crowd around the hull, each pulsing independent violet rhythms, the combined effect a stained-glass fever-dream lit from within by cold, living fire.
DEEP EMBER FIELD — an entire plain of low hydrothermal vents breathes red together, drifting mineral snow catching the glow, the submarine crossing above it like an airship over autumn harvest-fire.

MAST FOREST REQUIEM — the submarine navigates the tilted-mast graveyard at dead slow, searchlights finding figurehead faces still fixed in wooden anguish, encrusted crow's-nests housing pale anemone constellations.
GALLEON WRECK-HOARD — the barnacled wreck of a Spanish galleon slumps across a reef ledge, its rotted hold spilling gilded coins and tarnished chalices into the blue-dark water below.
HYDROTHERMAL EMBER-VENT — a volcanic vent erupts in sullen red glow, its shimmering thermals carrying drifting ember-sparks upward past the submarine's riveted hull like a deep-sea forge awakened.
LEVIATHAN STONE IDOL — a colossal stone leviathan-statue looms half-buried in pale silt, its vast carved mouth agape, encrusted in coral, older than any civilization the charts acknowledge.

SECOND JELLYFISH VEIL — a thinner curtain of moon-jellyfish drifts across the sub's course, each translucent bell pulsing soft silver, the whole swarm parting reluctantly around the brass hull's slow passage.
DEEP WHALE SILHOUETTE — high above, the whale's vast underside catches a streak of filtered sunlight, its flukes stirring the column of water until the submarine rocks gently in its wake.
BRASS CITY CLOCKTOWER — rising from the drowned city's plaza stands a brass clocktower still ticking, its dial glowing faint green through the deep, hands moving in the lightless eternal press.
VIOLET CORAL GROVE — smaller than a cathedral but no less strange, a violet coral grove clusters at the canyon's edge, each branch tipped in bioluminescent white like a candelabra mid-flame.

KELP-COLUMN CANOPY — the submarine surfaces briefly into the kelp-column canopy, fronds pressing the portholes, the green-gold light filtering through in long cathedral rays before the vessel descends once more.
GALLEON FIGUREHEAD — the galleon's gilded figurehead stares forward from the sediment, a crowned queen haloed in barnacles and sea-lace, still imperious, still navigating waters she will never leave.
VENT-FIELD EMBER-PLAIN — an entire plain of smaller vents exhales in concert, each glowing coal-red, the submarine gliding above them as though crossing the rooftop of some deep subterranean foundry.
CLOCKWORK FISH ESCORT — a lone mechanical fish matches the submarine's speed at the porthole, its copper scales catching the lamp-glow, regarding the crew with one unwavering amber jeweled eye.
LEVIATHAN HAND RUIN — only the hand remains of some larger statue, five immense stone fingers curling upward from the silt, the submarine threading between them like a fish through a cage.

MAST GRAVEYARD CLOSE — the sub navigates slowly through the tilted masts, crow's nests at eye level, tattered flags drifting like ghosts of their country, the whole graveyard silent and utterly still.

JELLYFISH AMBER COLUMN — a vertical column of amber-glowing jellyfish rises from floor to blackness above, a living chandelier-shaft the sub must curve wide around to save its propeller-works from entanglement.
WHALE SHADOW RETURN — the whale circles back overhead, its barnacled belly now close enough to read like a topographic map, the submarine dwarfed beneath it like a toy beside a warship.

DROWNED CITY LIBRARY — the submarine's lamp sweeps across a sunken library, its brass shelves intact, waterlogged volumes still upright, a reading-room lamp still burning green behind the cracked domed glass.
CORAL PULSE BLOOM — the bioluminescent coral exhales a sudden bloom of violet spores around the hull, each mote glowing as it drifts past the portholes in a slow galaxy of cold fire.

GALLEON GOLD SCATTER — scattered across bare rock beyond the wreck lies the galleon's true hoard, doubloons and jeweled crosses half-pressed into stone, gleaming in the submarine's passing lamp like buried stars.
GALLEON WRECK-HULK — a barnacled Spanish galleon lists against the seafloor, cannon mouths choked with coral, its burst hold spilling doubloons and rotted silk into the patient, silt-soft dark.

HYDROTHERMAL VENT FORGE — a hydrothermal vent blazes red-orange from the seabed, casting ember-drift and hellish light across the sub's copper hull, the water shimmering like heated glass above a furnace.
LEVIATHAN STONE-IDOL — a colossal carved stone leviathan rises half-buried from the silt, its serpentine jaw gaping skyward, ancient runes still legible across its barnacled flanks in the lamp-beam.

PHOSPHOR JELLYFISH VEIL — a slow curtain of moon-white jellyfish descends across the sub's bow, each bell pulsing in quiet rhythm, their light diffusing through the dark like lanterns behind wet silk.

GALLEON TREASURE-SPILL — gold coins and shattered casks tumble from the ruptured belly of a wrecked galleon, the submarine's lamp catching each doubloon in a slow, glittering cascade through black water.

KELP-TOWER CANOPY — the sub threads between vast kelp-columns whose upper fronds knit a swaying green ceiling overhead, filtering the deep's dim ambient glow into shifting cathedral-window patterns on the hull.

VENT-EMBER DRIFT — clouds of glowing particulate drift upward from a seabed vent like inverse snow, each mote burning briefly copper-red before cooling to nothing against the submarine's cold-riveted prow.

CLOCKWORK LEVIATHAN-FISH — a solitary mechanical fish the size of a carriage glides past with slow, deliberate fin-strokes, its brass plates etched with maker's marks, one glass eye slowly swiveling toward the porthole.

DROWNED CITY CLOCKTOWER — the brass sub drifts past a sunken clocktower, its hands still frozen at seven, gaslit face glowing faintly green through silt, fish circling its belfry like patient, spectral pigeons.
WHALE-BULK OVERHEAD — the blue-black belly of a whale fills the entire upper porthole, close enough to read the barnacle-constellations on its flank before the vast shape rolls and recedes into grey.

SILT-BURIED IDOL-HAND — only a colossal stone fist protrudes from the seafloor, fingers curled upward, each knuckle taller than the submarine's conning tower, its origin buried fathoms deep beneath the silt.
BIOLUM REEF-PULSE — the reef exhales light in slow waves, blue then violet then brief gold, illuminating the sub's porthole glass from without, the crew's faces painted in shifting undersea colour.

MAST-GRAVEYARD TANGLE — the submarine weaves among a forest of drowned masts, their crow's nests inhabited by swaying anemones, rigging connecting wreck to wreck like the web of some enormous patient spider.

MECHANICAL FISH VORTEX — the clockwork school wheels into a tight spiral around the submarine's hull, brass scales rattling softly against riveted iron, their synchronized clicking filling the observation chamber with strange mechanical music.

HYDROTHERMAL GLOW-CANYON — the sub descends into a rift valley lit red-gold from below, vent after vent burning along the canyon floor, the water shimmering in visible thermal waves, gorgeous and lethal.

SUNKEN CLOCKWORK CITY — toppled brass columns and flooded domed halls rise from the silt, a drowned Victorian city whose gaslit parlour windows glow amber still, impossibly, in the crushing dark.

GALLEON OF GOLD RUIN — a barnacled Spanish galleon lists at forty degrees, her gun-ports furred with growth, gold doubloons scattered like autumn leaves across the silt around her rotting, treasure-spilling hull.

MAST GRAVEYARD DRIFT — a field of tilted masts and broken yards stretches into the green murk, the rigging still hanging in ghostly curtains, a whole drowned navy resting at impossible, elegant angles.

DROWNED OBSERVATORY DOME — a cracked glass-and-brass observatory dome rests on the seabed, its telescope still pointed at the fathomless ceiling above, a lone deep-fish circling inside the shattered meridian ring.

GRAVEYARD OF LANTERNS — from the masts of the sunken fleet hang corroded brass lanterns, a few still burning by some uncanny miracle, their small warm flames nodding in the deep-sea current like mourners.
